program.name: Medicine (MBBS)
program.summary: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS), 5 years (10 semesters), October intake. Entrance test (MSAT-Malaysia, BMAT, MCAT, GAMSAT or equivalent) and interview required.

application_requirements.name: Admissions test
application_requirements.description: A high score in MSAT-Malaysia, BMAT, MCAT, GAMSAT or another equivalent approved by the Senate, from the current or previous year.

application_requirements.name: Interview
application_requirements.description: Interview is required for this course.

costs.note: International: RM 673,200 for the programme (UM's fee structure is based on the minimum period of study, 5 years), shown as RM 134,640 a year. Not inclusive of 6% Sales and Service Tax (SST).

admissions.threshold: Medicine (international): grade A in Biology and Chemistry and grade A in one of Physics / Mathematics (AAA). Entrance test and interview also required.
Medicine (international): IB 36 points, with at least 6 (HL) in two subjects and 6 (SL) in one subject. Entrance test and interview also required.
Medicine (Indian Pre-University, ICSE/CBSE and state boards): a minimum A in Biology and Chemistry and in one of Physics / Mathematics. Entrance test and interview also required.
